Product USP

A 2-step, high-moisture barrier routine for eczema-prone, severely dry & sensitive skin

MLE® Technology

Multi Lamellar Emulsion mimics healthy skin’s lipids, strengthening, moisturizing, and protecting dry, sensitive skin with Ceramide-9S.

Defensamide™

Defensamide helps maintain a healthy skin barrier by increasing the skin’s defense against various irritants.

CONTENT DO

  • +Film the real application process and texture in natural light
  • +Use softened language like "helps soothe, hydrate, and support the skin barrier"
  • +Clearly disclose gifted product with #Gifted
  • +Shoot Before/After photos with the same lighting and angle, unedited

CONTENT DON'T

  • −Don’t claim the product "cures" or "treats" eczema or dermatitis
  • −Don’t promise specific results or timelines (e.g. "clear in 3 days")
  • −Don’t compare directly to steroid medication or imply an equivalent effect
  • −Don’t heavily edit or filter Before/After photos
  • −Don’t omit the gifted-product disclosure
